baseline.printer: K1C with K1 Series CFS Upgrade

scope: Full observed box interface and preservation of its macro/configuration consumers; functional implementation remains pending.

stages.7: Full tool changes and print lifecycle
stages.8: Runout, recovery, resume and power loss

catalogue_validation.meaning: Checks inventory integrity and traceability, not CFS runtime correctness; planned functional checks are not passing tests.

references.scope: Published surrounding Klipper/macro behavior; not proof of the installed CFS Upgrade build or the origin of its binary modules.
Published K2 CFS integration: the baseline MCU image and sensor source match examined target copies. K2 native ARM/CPython 3.9 modules and mechanical configurations are not the K1C Upgrade baseline.

items.name: BOX_CUT_STATE
items.contract: Report the configured local cutter switch observation without interpreting it as proof of a completed cut.

items.name: BOX_SEND_DATA
items.parameters: [ADDR=<1..4>; default None] [STATE=<0..255>; default None] [CMD=<0..32>; default 10] [TIMEOUT=<1..120 seconds>; default 5] [DATA=<decimal digits>]
items.contract: Preserve the warning paths for missing address/state and encode each DATA digit as a separate byte. This interface does not accept a complete raw frame or add a new UART owner.

items.name: BOX_COMMUNICATION_TEST
items.parameters: ADDR=<1..4> NUM=<0..255> [COUNT=<0..1000000>; default 10] [TIMEOUT=<0..1 seconds>; default 0.1] [INTERVAL=<0.01..1 seconds>; default 0.1]
items.contract: Count communication mismatches and timeouts against the expected incremented byte modulo 256; preserve its dedicated reply path.

items.name: BOX_MODIFY_TN
items.parameters: <physical tool name>=<physical tool name> ...; names T1A..T4D
items.contract: Validate mapping keys and values, update the complete remap and persist it. Remapping alone does not execute a tool change.

items.name: BOX_MODIFY_TN_DATA
items.contract: Update supported live fields using their original field-specific conversions and save eligible metadata. Retain historical names such as vender and distinct empty/unknown sentinels.

items.name: BOX_MODIFY_TN_INNER_DATA
items.contract: Preserve supported inner-state updates; the public wrapper does not pass a sensor subpart and is not a generic setter for both sensor banks.

items.name: BOX_CREATE_CONNECT
items.contract: Issue the connect request unless print state is printing; a skipped request is not a new device observation.

items.name: BOX_EXTRUDE_PROCESS
items.parameters: ADDR=<1..9> NUM=<A/B/C/D> [STAGE=<1..9>; default 2, host version 1] [TRIGGER=<legacy value>; host version 0]
items.contract: Dispatch the encoding selected by the host configuration. Public STAGE, host-stage names and accepted wire stages must remain distinct; VELOCITY is not a parsed parameter.

items.name: BOX_RETRUDE_PROCESS
items.contract: Run the selected direct CFS retract phase, including all-slot/sentinel encoding where supported; preserve native status and failure semantics.

items.name: BOX_CTRL_CONNECTION_MOTOR_ACTION
items.contract: Forward the requested connection-motor action through the retained native API with command-specific status handling.

items.name: BOX_GET_FILAMENT_SENSOR_STATE
items.contract: Query the selected sensor bank and update the corresponding per-address mask without inventing freshness for an unsuccessful query.

items.name: BOX_SET_BOX_MODE
items.contract: Select the requested mode and slot; PRINT and IDLE request encodings differ from the stored mode numbers.

items.name: BOX_GET_BUFFER_STATE
items.contract: Query the buffer and update the single shared buffer cache; an address argument does not create an independent buffer per box.

items.name: BOX_GET_RFID
items.contract: Query selected slots and apply the RFID/metadata result path, distinguishing busy, unknown and none. The public NUM requirement differs from the helper default of all slots.

items.name: BOX_GET_REMAIN_LEN
items.contract: Read selected remaining-percentage bytes and update their historical string values; do not relabel the field as measured millimetres.

items.name: BOX_GET_BOX_STATE
items.contract: Decode normal telemetry, slot events and fault responses separately. A slot event can update communication state without refreshing ordinary mode/temperature/humidity.

items.name: BOX_SET_PRE_LOADING
items.parameters: [ADDR=<1..4>; omitted parser default 0 selects connected boxes] ACTION=CLOSE/OPEN/RUN/TIGHT [NUM=<mask 0..15>; default 0] [POWER_ON=ENABLE/DISABLE]
items.contract: Update RAM preload preferences and dispatch the selected permission or procedure with print-state and head-sensor guards. A skipped native call can still change preferences.

items.name: BOX_MEASURING_WHEEL
items.contract: Reset or read the wheel; preserve ADDR as the public address parameter and the float32 reply ordering.

items.name: BOX_TIGHTEN_UP_ENABLE
items.contract: Control tighten-up using the observed inverted wire values, ENABLE=0 and DISABLE=1.

items.name: TEST_BOX_CLEAN
items.contract: Provide the registered alias of the same nozzle-cleaning handler and preserve the same observable behavior.

items.name: BOX_NOZZLE_CLEAN
items.contract: Run the configured nozzle-cleaning movements, waits, fan actions and temporary motion limits.

items.name: BOX_MOVE_TO_SAFE_POS
items.contract: Move toward configured safe Y only when both X and Y are homed; retain the no-motion path for an unhomed printer.

items.name: BOX_TN_EXTRUDE
items.contract: Invoke the configured extruder-feed operation using the existing configured length/velocity/percentage values.

items.name: BOX_BLOW
items.contract: Set fan0 to 1, wait three seconds, then set fan0 to 0 through the documented dedicated blow sequence.

items.name: BOX_GET_FLUSH_LEN
items.contract: Calculate/report purge length using source/target colours, configured nozzle volume and multiplier; this calculation does not execute the purge.

items.name: BOX_GO_TO_EXTRUDE_POS
items.contract: Move to the configured extrusion/purge position, preserving its resume guard and existing coordinate modes.

items.name: BOX_GO_TO_BOX_EXTRUDE_POS
items.contract: Move to the configured position for CFS-side feed/retract operations using the retained user coordinates.

items.name: BOX_MOVE_TO_CUT
items.contract: Execute configured cutter movement with temporary motion limits and the applicable sensor or blind-repeat path.

items.name: BOX_SAVE_FAN
items.contract: Save available fan0/fan2 speeds and set them to zero, respecting absent-fan cases.

items.name: BOX_RESTORE_FAN
items.contract: Restore previously saved fan0/fan2 speeds and clear the saved values after the documented restoration path.

items.name: BOX_END
items.contract: Complete the context-dependent end route, including possible cutting, draining/unloading, mode normalisation and safe positioning with its own saved-error class.

items.name: BOX_CUT_MATERIAL
items.contract: Save/close the model fan as required and perform the cut phase, preserving its resume guard and macro-cut error handling.

items.name: BOX_RETRUDE_MATERIAL
items.contract: Unload the current or inferred source and record the appropriate macro retract error on failure; honour the main unload resume guard.

items.name: BOX_EXTRUDE_MATERIAL
items.contract: Run the complete box-side loading phase with its error-context and macro-replay behavior; honour the resume guard and separate physical completion from saved source hints.

items.name: BOX_EXTRUDER_EXTRUDE
items.contract: Perform the extruder pickup/feed phase with its own error family and tray/tower conditions; honour its resume guard.

items.name: BOX_START_PRINT_EXTRUDE_MATERIAL
items.contract: Read the first tool from virtual-SD print metadata, preserve start-print retraction data and perform the tool action when a target exists.

items.name: BOX_MATERIAL_FLUSH
items.contract: Execute standalone configured feeding/purging; out-of-range TEMP falls back to the configured temperature. This command does not parse TNN and honours its resume guard.

items.name: BOX_MATERIAL_CHANGE_FLUSH
items.contract: Select the source/target-specific purge length, temperature and segmented feed profile, preserving deferred macro handling when an error is already active.

items.name: BOX_RETRUDE_MATERIAL_WITH_TNN
items.contract: Unload the specified or sensor-inferred material through this distinct public route; do not copy the main unload resume guard into it by assumption.

items.name: BOX_EXTRUDE_2_PROCESS
items.contract: Preserve the separate legacy model2 interface and resolve its observed request-length conflict before executing its mechanical route.

items.name: BOX_GET_VERSION_SN
items.contract: Read version and serial identity for the specified box, preserving compatible string values and the distinction from hardware family and host configuration version.

items.name: BOX_GENERATE_FLUSH_ARRAY
items.parameters: FLUSH_ARRAY=<4x4 values; rows separated by underscore, columns by comma>
items.contract: Parse/report the diagnostic 4-by-4 flush matrix with the established delimiters and invalid-input behavior.

items.name: BOX_SHOW_TNN_INNER_DATA
items.contract: Print a deep-copied presentation of state with known colour labels without replacing the underlying live values with the display representation.

items.name: BOX_ENABLE_AUTO_REFILL
items.contract: Update the RAM auto-refill preference; preserve the public parser distinction from the bounded CFS-print enable command.

items.name: BOX_CHECK_MATERIAL_REFILL
items.contract: Evaluate ending-material/runout state and schedule the refill callback; callback registration is not synchronous execution or completion.

items.name: BOX_TNN_RETRY_PROCESS
items.contract: Select the saved reason-specific retry path, preserve the resume guard, macro replay rules and after-extrusion/cooling/RESUME decisions based on saved error context.

items.name: BOX_ERROR_CLEAR
items.contract: Perform the reason-specific conditional IDLE requests and host error/context/macro-queue clearing; clearing host state does not establish a physical rollback.

items.name: BOX_START_PRINT
items.contract: Apply start-of-print preload policy and disable tighten-up for connected boxes, preserving the helper print-state guards.

items.name: BOX_END_PRINT
items.contract: Apply end preload policy, enable tighten-up, reset remapping/resume fields, disable CFS printing and disable the head callback sensor. This cleanup differs from BOX_END.

items.name: BOX_ENABLE_CFS_PRINT
items.contract: Update and persist CFS-print enable and control the corresponding head callback sensor; preserve the required bounded parameter.

items.name: BOX_POWER_LOSS_RESTORE
items.contract: Restore saved enable, full remapping and source hints without declaring that physical filament position has been established.

items.name: BOX_UPDATE_SAME_MATERIAL_LIST
items.contract: Rebuild same-material groups by type and colour while excluding unusable identities; candidate sensor checks remain a later separate operation.

items.name: BOX_EXTRUSION_ALL_MATERIALS
items.contract: Run the remaining-material drain route with its macro error conversion; the documented successful route clears the saved source and disables the head callback sensor.

items.name: BOX_CUT_HALL_ZERO
items.contract: Expose cutter zero/calibration only when the configured switch makes this registration available.

items.name: BOX_CUT_HALL_TEST
items.contract: Expose the Hall cutter diagnostic movement only when the configured switch makes this registration available.

items.name: BOX_GET_FLUSH_VELOCITY_TEST
items.contract: Calculate/report the material-dependent feed profile for a source/target pair without treating logged output as a completed feed.

items.name: MOVE_BOX_PRE_CUT_POS
items.contract: Run the configured pre-cut positioning route, including its possible homing and bed-mesh clearing effects.

items.name: MOVE_BOX_CUT_POS
items.contract: Run the effective cutter-position route, including possible homing and bed-mesh clearing effects.

items.name: SAVE_BOX_CFG
items.contract: Back up the selected existing configuration and apply pending changes with the recovered line/section handling; preserve unrelated settings and wrappers.

items.name: MODIFY_BOX_CFG
items.contract: Modify supported RAM configuration and the pending-save dictionary using the recovered field-specific conversion and truthiness rules; runtime bounds differ from loader and UI bounds.

items.name: TEST_BOX_EXTRUDE
items.contract: Run the configured extrusion-position test route, including possible homing and movement synchronisation.

items.name: BOX_FIND_CUT_POS
items.contract: Check the filament precondition, home/search with the cut sensor and temporary acceleration, then modify/save cutter Y only on the documented success path.

items.name: BOX_GET_FIVE_WAY_STATE
items.contract: Query CONNECTIONS for connected boxes and update the corresponding state markers; keep per-address observation and result handling distinct.

items.name: DO_AFTER_PAUSE
items.contract: Wait for the required pause condition and invoke the existing after-pause hook. WAIT_PAUSE is a macro dependency rather than another registered box command.

items.name: RESTORE_POSITION
items.contract: Restore the post-extrusion motion context through the documented path, preserving its resume-time no-action guard.

items.name: BOX_ADD_TNN
items.contract: Set the deferred resume target on the existing virtual_sdcard object; recording the target does not execute or complete the later tool change.

items.name: BOX_SAVE_EXTRUDE_POS
items.contract: Store the supplied or current XY through configuration modification and saving without altering unrelated configuration.

items.name: BOX_CUSTOM_COMMAND
items.contract: Dispatch only the established custom homing/move/save actions and update the string custom-command result for clients.

items.name: WAIT_EXTRUSION_ALL_MATERIALS
items.contract: Wait cooperatively for the auto-refill and draining guards to clear; this command does not initiate either operation.

items.name: BOX_RESUME_EXTRUDE
items.contract: Run the specialised resume feed path using saved/remapped target and current observations, with its own positioning, heat, fan, E and cleaning sequence.

items.name: SET_BOX_MODE_PRINT_WHEN_NOZZLE_CLEAR
items.contract: Check the material and connection banks and restore the active PRINT context after nozzle clearing through the dedicated service path.
